intro: Translate Abercrombie's Note is an Alliance quest in Darkshire that tasks an adventurer with carrying an indecipherable letter to the town's resident scholar. Lord Ello Ebonlocke cannot make sense of the hermit's missive, relying instead on Sirra Von'Indi's knowledge of obscure scripts. It marks the moment Darkshire's leadership realizes Abercrombie's odd errands hide something far more deliberate.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take the note you gave me to Sirra Von'Indi. He's very learned in languages and ancient arts - if anyone here can translate this message, it's he.

clips.title: Progress
paras: A note from Abercrombie the hermit, eh? I don't know him, though if he lives out at the graveyard then I do know his brains have rotted out!
